On the excitation Hilbert space the block operator is [[M,Bdag],[B,C]], with M=WdagLW, B=RLW and C=RLR. P preserves D(L), and removing the bounded off-diagonal B+Bdag from selfadjoint L gives a selfadjoint block-diagonal operator on D(L). Thus the compression C is selfadjoint on R D(L), and is nonnegative when L is. This supplies a precise sufficient finite-rank domain argument, once actual source membership in D(L) is established.
